title: `except Exception as e: raise db_exc.DBError(e)` hides the original exception type
detail: Line 172 catches `Exception` and re-raises as `db_exc.DBError`, discarding the original exception type and the chained traceback. Any caller catching `db_exc.DBError` will not be able to distinguish a network error from a logic error. Suggested fix: use `raise db_exc.DBError(e) from e` to preserve the chain, and narrow the catch to only the DB driver exceptions that `DBError` is meant to wrap.
